method.method_draft: Read the image as a trapezoid with bottom base QP = 26 ft, top base MN unknown, and perpendicular height 18 ft shown by the dashed segment. From the text, area is 360 平方英尺. Decompose the trapezoid into a central rectangle of width MN and height 18 plus the leftover side triangular region(s), whose combined horizontal base is 26 - MN and whose height is 18. Then area = 18(MN) + (1/2)(18)(26 - MN). Set this equal to 360 and solve: 18MN + 9(26 - MN) = 360, so 9MN + 234 = 360, MN = 14.
